notes.t110: gpio73=PC9 status LED (0.5s heartbeat, now via .dtsi gpio-leds); gpio58=PB26 WiFi IRQ; gpio62=PB30 SD-CD active-high + gpio30=PA30 reset button + led_b now flow through the .dtsi fragment (kernel DT, U-Boot injection, BUTTON_PIN all derive from it); gpio61=PB29 SD power (active-low enable, BENCH-CONFIRMED 2026-10-26 via U-Boot gpio clear 61 + mmc rescan; stays runtime-side via gpio.mmc_power -> S09mmc); gpio60=PB28 REGON stays in wlan seq; speaker amp en gpio63. gpio46=IR LED, gpio49/50=ircut pair, gpio75=white lamp (reserve until hardware-verified). MOTORS (decoded 2026-10-27 from stock motor.ko by Josh, SMHLROQP cipher, letter = GPIO code-64): pan phases 40/44/45/51 (PC8/PC12/PC13/PC19), tilt 47/48/49/50 (PC15-18, matches stock pwm-pc group), steps 5300/1100. Requires package/ingenic-sdk 0004 patch (ciao-pinned SDK lacks the 4.4.94 unified module-param interface; master's thingino/ingenic-sdk pin already has it upstream). No limit switches. Homing stays off until arrow-pad direction is bench-proven.
